whyitmatters.title: Why does this matter?
whyitmatters.p1: There are over 90 European ETFs available to buy, each moving differently every day. Tracking all of them alone means hours comparing charts — or, more often, deciding by instinct and hoping it works out.
whyitmatters.p2: ET-Spotter reduces that complexity to a single score per ETF. Instead of scanning dozens of indicators, you see one number: the higher it is, the stronger the ETF is right now. A 30-second read replaces an afternoon of analysis.
whyitmatters.p3: This doesn't tell you what to buy — it tells you where the market's strength is today, so your next decision (rebalance, hold, add) is informed by data, not guesswork.

trust.title: Why you can trust this score
trust.methodology_body: Each ETF gets a score between 0 and 1, calculated from momentum, trend and risk indicators, compared across every ETF in the analysed universe. The methodology follows published academic research on momentum and factor investing — it's not a secret formula, and not a personal opinion.
trust.transparency_body: Every signal we issue is logged and reviewable — the ones that worked out and the ones that didn't. We don't hide the signals that failed. The longer ET-Spotter runs, the longer (and more verifiable) this track record becomes.
trust.limitations_body: ET-Spotter describes what the data shows today; it doesn't predict the future and doesn't replace professional financial advice. The score is a statistical measure of relative strength — not a buy or sell recommendation, and it doesn't account for your personal financial situation.

forwhom.title: Who this is for
forwhom.yes_body: ET-Spotter is for people who already invest (or are starting to invest) in European UCITS ETFs and rebalance their portfolio periodically — monthly or quarterly — and want an objective second opinion before deciding, without spending hours analysing charts.
forwhom.no_body: If you're looking for intraday trading signals, buy/sell recommendations, or an order-execution tool, ET-Spotter isn't for you — we're not a broker or a trading service. If you invest in individual stocks, crypto or other assets outside the European UCITS ETF universe, this isn't the right product for that need either.
